prompt: Why should a visitor show the tag when asking for a different size?
promptZh: 為什麼換尺寸時應出示鞋內的標籤？

options.text: To show that the shoes have already been paid for
options.whyZh: 試鞋免費；鞋內標籤是用來辨識鞋款，不是付款證明。

options.text: To help staff find the right style in another size
options.zh: 讓工作人員找出同款的另一個尺寸
options.whyZh: 拿另一個尺寸時，志工能靠標籤分辨外觀相似的鞋款。

options.text: To find out who donated that pair
options.whyZh: 公告沒說鞋子是捐來的，也沒要求查出捐贈者。

options.text: To have the tag removed before trying on the shoes
options.zh: 請人在試穿前拆掉標籤
options.whyZh: 講者要求出示鞋內標籤，沒有要求拆掉。

explanationZh: 拿另一個尺寸時，志工能靠標籤分辨外觀相似的鞋款。
evidence: For a different size, show the volunteer the tag inside the shoe. / Pairs can look alike; the tag identifies the style.

evidenceSpans.speaker: Narrator
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: For a different size, show the volunteer the tag inside the shoe.

evidenceSpans.speaker: Narrator
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Pairs can look alike; the tag identifies the style.
